mapper.sql: t.*, fw.name AS from_warehouse_name, tw.name AS to_warehouse_name, fm.owh_code AS from_owh_code, tm.owh_code AS to_owh_code, i.inbound_no, i.status AS inbound_status

FROM ecom_owh_transfer t LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse fw ON fw.id = t.from_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse tw ON tw.id = t.to_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse fm ON fm.id = t.from_mapping_id LEFT JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse tm ON tm.id = t.to_mapping_id LEFT JOIN ecom_owh_inbound i ON i.id = t.inbound_id

sql.if: AND (t.transfer_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.owh_out_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.transfer_doc_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.tracking_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT t.status AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM ecom_owh_transfer t
GROUP BY t.status
SELECT * FROM ecom_owh_transfer WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.id FROM ecom_owh_transfer t LEFT JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse fm ON fm.id = t.from_mapping_id LEFT JOIN ecom_owh_account fa ON fa.id = fm.account_id LEFT JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse tm ON tm.id = t.to_mapping_id LEFT JOIN ecom_owh_account ta ON ta.id = tm.account_id WHERE (t.status = 'OUT_PUSHED' AND fa.status = 1 AND fa.auto_sync = 1) OR (t.status = 'IN_TRANSIT' AND t.to_mapping_id IS NOT NULL AND ta.status = 1 AND ta.auto_sync = 1) ORDER BY t.id
